name: 新 HSK 六级（3.0）
note: New HSK (3.0) format from the official 2026 sample paper: 82 questions, about 125 minutes. The speaking paper (HSK六级口语) is separate. Section scores out of 100, the 180 pass mark and the writing weights are estimates; the new scoring has not been published.

sections.name: 听力 Listening
sections.intro: 大家好！欢迎参加HSK六级考试。HSK六级听力考试分三部分，共40题。请大家注意，听力考试现在开始。

parts.title: 第一部分
parts.rubric:
Score 0-40 (new HSK 6 practical writing — notice, letter, post, application, etc. — at least 150 characters; count every character incl. punctuation):
36-40 = does everything the task asks, in the right format and register for its purpose and reader; clear, well-organised, precise HSK 6-level language; almost no errors
28-35 = covers the task in a suitable format; some minor errors or a small omission
20-27 = covers most of the task but format/register is off or content thin; several errors
10-19 = misses important parts of the task, or many errors, or well under 120 characters
1-9 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).

parts.title: 第二部分
parts.rubric:
Score 0-60 (new HSK 6 argumentative essay, at least 300 characters; count every character incl. punctuation):
54-60 = clear position answering the prompt; well-reasoned arguments with examples; logical structure and cohesion; rich, accurate HSK 6-level vocabulary and complex sentences; almost no errors; 300+ characters
42-53 = clear position and reasonable support; organised; some minor errors
30-41 = position present but support thin or repetitive; several errors that rarely block meaning
15-29 = unclear position or largely off topic, or many errors, or well under 240 characters
1-14 = very little relevant, correct Chinese
0 = blank or not Chinese
Deduct 1 per wrongly written character (max 5).
